info.name: Gallica & BnF APIs (France)
info.description:
Bibliothèque nationale de France: **Gallica** digital library (SRU search, Document API, IIIF) and the **BnF catalogue** SRU. No key. Responses are XML except IIIF (JSON/images).

Docs: https://api.bnf.fr/fr/api-gallica-de-recherche · https://api.bnf.fr/fr/api-document-de-gallica · https://api.bnf.fr/fr/api-iiif-de-recuperation-des-images-de-gallica · https://api.bnf.fr/fr/api-sru-catalogue-general

Please be polite: Gallica uses Cloudflare and blocks aggressive or undocumented traffic.

request.description: Searches metadata and OCR text of 10M+ documents: books, newspapers, maps, images, manuscripts. Results are Dublin Core XML; the Visualizer shows a table.
OCR text only. Finds a name mentioned anywhere inside newspaper pages or books.
dc.type "fascicule" means newspaper and periodical issues.
collapsing=false returns each periodical issue separately instead of grouping them by title.
Dublin Core and Gallica metadata for one document.
Page numbers and labels; needed for IIIF page fN.

item.name: ★ Find a word inside a document (ContentSearch)

request.description: Shows which pages contain the word, with text snippets. Useful for locating a surname inside a 500-page volume.
Only for documents that have a TOC (otherwise 400).
Full OCR text as an HTML page.
Lists each issue with its document id (ark).
IIIF Presentation 2.0 manifest; works in Mirador and Universal Viewer.
BnF general catalogue (print holdings, not only digitized).
Example: genealogy and Hongrie returned 140 records.
